newsitem.title: UK: ADT in marketing tie-up with AT&T.
newsitem.headline: ADT in marketing tie-up with AT&T.

text.p: Electronic security products group ADT Ltd said on Tuesday its U.S. unit ADT Security Services Inc. had signed a joint marketing agreement with U.S. telecommunications group AT&T Corporation.

Under the agreement, AT&T's residential customers will be eligible for offers and discounts on ADT electronic security services and AT&T's sales force will refer business customers to ADT. In return, ADT will promote AT&T's residential long distance services to its customers, ADT said in a statement.
ADT chairman and chief executive Michael Ashcroft said the deal was a cost-effective way to gain new customers.
Bermuda-based ADT said it was the largest provider of electronic security services in North America and Britain. The company gave no details of the expected financial impact of the deal or its cost.
